regime_context: Hong Kong market is in a dominant one-narrative regime with Tech Hardware & Semis as the clear leader (trend-eligible, durable, not crowded). The absolute-trend gate has historically mitigated drawdowns here (gate_helps=true). Only 5 of 17 themes are eligible; the rest lack trend protection. Macro backdrop is coincidently dominated by AI/tech headlines.
emerging_watch: Diversified Miners (challenger, rank #2) – if it becomes eligible and the margin to Tech Hardware narrows below 0.5 while Tech Hardware durability wanes, a confirmed handoff could be forming. Kill criterion: Tech Hardware score re-accelerates or miners lose eligibility/momentum.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: The theme exhibits strong, durable trend leadership (hurst=trend, durability_bar=0.67) and passes the absolute-trend gate, which is the only validated risk-control edge in HK. Staying with eligible trends has historically contained drawdowns. We lean overweight while the trend structure holds, with the AI macro narrative a coincidental tailwind.
evidence: Rank #1 momentum score (2.188) – attention lens, not alpha
theses.dissent: Trend may be exhausted; HK tech hardware is vulnerable to geopolitical shocks or mean-reversion (breadth only 0.333). AI macro excitement could prove temporary, leading to abrupt rotation.

falsifier.text: The theme loses absolute-trend gate eligibility (e.g., durability_bar falls below 0.5 and hurst flips to mean-revert, or breadth collapses below 0.2 on the next detector update).

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: The theme is ineligible on the absolute-trend gate, indicating elevated drawdown risk without the validated protection that the gate provides. Score is negative (-0.153) and durability is moderate (0.50), so we lean underweight until it re-qualifies for trend eligibility.
evidence: Not crowded (z=-0.50) – no reflexivity reason to buy
theses.dissent: Breadth is high (0.778), and some platform names may benefit from AI/tech spillover. The low score may signal oversold conditions, risking a sharp rebound that makes underweight costly.

falsifier.text: If China Platform Megacaps becomes eligible on the absolute-trend gate and its momentum score turns positive, the underweight lean is invalidated.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
